items.headline: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.excerpt: We are bringing Gemini 4 Hydrogen to Google Search globally to provide you with more helpful, visual, and intuitive responses.

items.headline: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
items.excerpt: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

items.headline: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together.
items.excerpt: Tabletop is a new Google Labs experiment for group collaboration. Build interactive itineraries, polls, and brackets with your team. Join the waitlist.

items.headline: Experience the art and legacy of Dr. Esther Mahlangu
items.excerpt: A new online archive of Esther Mahlangu’s life and art is now on Google Arts & Culture.

items.headline: Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
items.excerpt: Gemini Intelligence is rolling out to more devices. See how expanded capabilities across these devices help you do more.

items.headline: We’re bringing Adobe’s creative and productivity tools closer to your everyday Google apps.
items.excerpt: Google and Adobe are integrating creative and productivity tools. Edit PDFs in Drive and use Adobe AI in Gemini. See what’s new in this partnership.

items.headline: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
items.excerpt: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare to unify clinical data and automate workflows. Reduce administrative burnout. See how it works.
